title: Return to the Guide Origin
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a,R,j\in\bbn$, and fix an input word and base configuration for the schedule machine built from $W$ and $a$. For any input-head position, budget-head position and tape, unary-head position and tape, and base configuration, starting in the start-center phase with guide head at $-j$ and guide tape of radius $R$, after $j+1$ steps the machine is in the macrostep-check phase with guide head at $0$; the resulting configuration is the setup configuration with all the same data and other head positions.
hypotheses_covered: An input word and base configuration
Integer budget-head position and budget tape
Integer unary-head position and unary tape
Guide-head position initially $-j$ and guide tape of radius $R$
replaced:
For every $j \in \bbn$: from a setup configuration in the start-center phase with guide
head at cell $-j$ over the completed guide of radius $R$, exactly $j+1$ steps reach the
origin and enter the macrostep-check phase with guide head at cell $0$; all tapes and
all other heads are unchanged.
